title: Would you try camping?
instruction: Watch the plan take shape. Compare the problems and benefits, then choose your kind of trip

video.title: The First Guy To Ever Go Camping

items.prompt: How does his friend plan to make a shelter?
items.hint: Listen for the material and the things used to hold it up
items.answer: He plans to make four walls and a roof with fabric, sticks and pegs

items.prompt: Why does the hesitant man think staying at home would be easier?
items.hint: Compare the equipment and comfort with what they already have at home
items.answer: Even with lots of equipment, camping seems to give them a less comfortable version of their setup at home

items.prompt: What makes him change his mind about camping?
items.hint: Listen to what they could disconnect from and enjoy instead
items.answer: The idea of leaving their comforts and devices behind, reconnecting with nature and looking at the stars makes camping sound appealing

items.prompt: Would you try camping? Explain a benefit and a change, then ask your teacher
items.hint: Use I’d choose… because… and I’d change…
items.answer: Example: I’d try a short camping trip because I’d like to spend time outdoors. I’d choose a campsite with proper facilities and check the weather first. What would you choose?
